prompt: The product team flagged users 17, 128, 129 and 278 for odd gaps between their app events. Build their session table for November 2025: use only their app events from 1 to 30 November 2025 (UTC days of event_ts), so each user's first event in November starts session 1. A user's first app event starts a session, and an event more than 30 minutes after the same user's previous event starts a new one; an event exactly 30 minutes later stays in the same session. Measure each gap as the time between the two moments in event_ts, a UTC instant, never between clock times. For each session, show the user, its number (counting from 1 for each user in time order), its first event's event_ts, how many events it holds, and its length in seconds from its first to its last event (0 for a session of one event). Return five columns, in this order: user_id, session_no, session_start, events and length_seconds. Return one row for each session. Any row order is fine.

output_contract.grain: one row per session of the four users in November 2025

hints: Next, flag the session starts and turn the flags into a session number with a running sum.
Once every event carries its user and session number, one GROUP BY on the two gives the start, the count and the length.
faded_shape:
WITH gaps AS (
  -- one row per app event of the four users in November 2025
  SELECT event_id, user_id, event_ts,
    LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS prev_ts
  FROM app_events
  WHERE user_id IN (17, 128, 129, 278)
    AND event_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-11-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND event_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-12-01 00:00:00+00'
), flagged AS (
  -- one row per app event of the four users in November 2025
  SELECT event_id, user_id, event_ts,
why_this_works: The running sum gives every event its session number, so grouping by user and session number turns the events into sessions.
faded_suffix:
FROM flagged
)
SELECT user_id, session_no, MIN(event_ts) AS session_start, COUNT(*) AS events,
  epoch(MAX(event_ts)) - epoch(MIN(event_ts)) AS length_seconds
FROM numbered
GROUP BY user_id, session_no
